comparison.objective: Latch a tool-less server rail into the rear and front flanges of the same rack U; candidate separates finishing media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Peg-to-square-hole alignment, latch insertion, telescoping rail extension, and level placement versus pouring and bimanual agitation of a perforated screen.
comparison.success_condition: Both rail ends must latch at the marked U, remain within 0.5° of level, not fall, and be released for 2 s; partial credit is rear latch only. Candidate instead requires full feed transfer, ≥98% media recovery, washer retention, no loss/damage, and 3 s released support. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Rack-rail alignment and sequential latching test rigid insertion geometry, not granular classification.
